note: Open questions for the decision frame, rooted at Will. One per facet in the Lean will_order, and one per coercion source. Questions describe and ask; they never assume an answer, prescribe or predict.

root.voluntary_involuntary: Was going something you chose, something that happened without your choosing, or something you felt forced into?
root.desire: How much did you want to go, if at all?
root.attachment: Who, if anyone, were you going for or with?
root.imagination: What else could you have done instead?
root.reason: What made you pick this over the other options?
root.conscience: Did you feel you ought to go? Why or why not?
root.temporality: When did you decide, and how long did it take?
root.emotion: What did you feel as you decided?
root.embodiment: How was your body when you decided: rested, tired, restless, in pain?
root.intuition: Did you have a sense, before thinking it through, of what to do?
root.self-differentiation: Does going feel like you, or like someone else's idea of you?
root.attention: What were you focused on when you decided?
root.awareness: Were you aware of deciding at the time, or did you notice only afterwards?
root.logos: How would you put the decision into words?
root.aesthetic-sense: Was there anything about it you found beautiful or appealing in itself?
root.numinous-sense: Did it touch anything you hold sacred?
root.will: How firmly did you hold to the decision once you made it?

coercion_sources.attachment: Did the pressure come from someone? Who?
coercion_sources.embodiment: Did it come from your body, such as a need, a pain or exhaustion?
coercion_sources.conscience: Did it come from a sense of duty or obligation?
coercion_sources.shared_inner: Did it come from circumstances outside you that others would recognize?
